bookInfo.name: New History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷五 唐本紀第五: 莊宗下
title.raw: 卷五 唐本紀第五: 莊宗下 Volume 5 Later Tang Annals 2: Zhuangzong 2

sentences.zh: 存勖，克用長子也。

translations.literal: Cunxu was Keyong’s eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu was the eldest son of Li Keyong.

sentences.zh: 初，克用破孟方立於邢州，還軍上黨，置酒三垂崗，伶人奏《百年歌》，至於衰老之際，聲甚悲，坐上皆淒愴。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Keyong had defeated Meng Fangli at Xingzhou, he returned his army to Shangdang and set out wine at Triple Mound Ridge. Entertainers performed the “Song of a Hundred Years,” and when they reached the passage on old age the tone was very mournful; all at the table were grief-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: Long before, after Keyong routed Meng Fangli at Xingzhou, he marched back to Shangdang and feasted at Triple Mound Ridge. Players sang the “Song of a Hundred Years”; at the lines on growing old the music turned so bleak that every guest at the table wept.

sentences.zh: 時存勖在側，方五歲，克用慨然捋須，指而笑曰：「吾行老矣，此奇兒也，後二十年，其能代我戰於此乎！

translations.literal: Cunxu was then at his side, only five years old. Keyong, stirred, stroked his beard, pointed at the boy, and laughed: “I am growing old. What a remarkable child! Twenty years from now, will he be able to fight here in my place?
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu stood beside him, just five. Keyong sighed, tugged his beard, pointed at the boy, and said with a laugh: “I am old. Here is a wonder—will he stand in my stead on this field twenty years hence?

sentences.zh: 」存勖年十一，從克用破王行瑜，遣獻捷於京師，昭宗異其狀貌，賜以鸂鶒卮、翡翠盤，而撫其背曰：「兒有奇表，後當富貴，無忘予家。

translations.literal: ” When Cunxu was eleven he followed Keyong in defeating Wang Xingyu and was sent to present the victory report at the capital. Zhaozong marveled at his looks, bestowed a xichi goblet and a jadeite platter, and stroking his back said: “The boy has an extraordinary countenance; later he will be rich and noble—do not forget my house.
translations.idiomatic: ” At eleven Cunxu rode with Keyong against Wang Xingyu and carried the victory dispatch to court. Emperor Zhaozong was struck by his bearing, gave him a mandarin-duck goblet and a jade dish, and patting his back said: “You have the look of greatness; fortune will find you—do not forget our house.

sentences.zh: 」及長，善騎射，膽勇過人，稍習《春秋》，通大義，尤喜音聲歌舞俳優之戲。

translations.literal: ” When he had grown up he excelled at riding and archery, his daring surpassed others, he studied the Spring and Autumn Annals a little and grasped its larger principles, and he especially delighted in music, song, dance, and comic players’ performances.
translations.idiomatic: ” Grown to manhood, he was a superb horseman and archer, bolder than any around him. He read something of the Spring and Autumn Annals and caught its moral sense, but he loved music, song, dance, and the players’ stage above all else.

sentences.zh: 天祐五年正月，即王位於太原。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Tianyou he assumed the royal title at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianyou 5 (908) he took the throne as king at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 叔父克寧殺都虞候李存質，幸臣史敬镕告克寧謀叛。

translations.literal: His uncle Kening killed the chief military adjutant Li Cunzhi; a favored minister, Shi Jingrong, reported that Kening was plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Kening murdered chief military adjutant Li Cunzhi. A court favorite, Shi Jingrong, accused Kening of treason.

sentences.zh: 二月，執而戕之，且以先王之喪、叔父之難告周德威，德威自亂柳還軍太原。

translations.literal: In the second month he seized and killed Kening, and he also informed Zhou Dewei of the late king’s death and his uncle’s treachery; Dewei withdrew his army from Luanliu and returned to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he arrested and executed Kening, then sent word to Zhou Dewei of his father’s death and his uncle’s revolt. Dewei broke camp at Luanliu and marched back to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 梁夾城兵聞晉有大喪，德威軍且去，因頗懈。

translations.literal: The Liang troops at Jia Fortress heard that Jin was in deep mourning and that Dewei’s army was about to leave, and so grew quite slack.
translations.idiomatic: Liang’s besiegers at Jia Fortress heard of the Jin mourning and of Dewei’s withdrawal, and their guard went slack.

sentences.zh: 王謂諸將曰：「梁人幸我大喪，謂我少而新立，無能為也，宜乘其怠擊之。

translations.literal: The king told his generals: “The Liang, rejoicing at our great mourning, think me young and newly enthroned and incapable of action—we should strike while they are idle.
translations.idiomatic: The king told his commanders: “Liang thinks our mourning has left a boy on the throne who cannot act. We should hit them while they drowse.

sentences.zh: 」乃出兵趨上黨，行至三重崗，嘆曰：「此先王置酒處也！

translations.literal: ” He thereupon marched out toward Shangdang. When he reached Triple Mound Ridge he sighed: “This is where the late king set out wine!
translations.idiomatic: ” He marched for Shangdang. At Triple Mound Ridge he stopped and said: “Here my father once feasted!

sentences.zh: 」會天大霧晝暝，兵行霧中，攻其夾城，破之，梁軍大敗，凱旋告廟。

translations.literal: ” Heaven sent a great fog that darkened the day; his troops moved through the mist, attacked Jia Fortress, broke it, and the Liang army was utterly defeated. He returned in triumph and reported to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: ” A fog so thick it dimmed the noonday sun swallowed his columns; they struck Jia Fortress through the murk, smashed it, and routed the Liang host. He came home in triumph and offered the victory at the temple.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀王王建、岐王李茂貞及楊崇本攻梁大安，晉亦遣周德威攻其晉州，敗梁軍於神山。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Shu king Wang Jian, the Qi king Li Maozhen, and Yang Chongben attacked Liang’s Da’an; Jin also sent Zhou Dewei against its Jinzhou and defeated the Liang army at Spirit Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wang Jian of Shu, Li Maozhen of Qi, and Yang Chongben struck Liang at Da’an. Jin sent Zhou Dewei against Jinzhou and beat Liang at Spirit Mountain.

sentences.zh: 六年，劉知俊叛梁，來乞師，王自將至陰地關，遣周德威攻晉州，敗梁軍於蒙阮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Liu Zhijun rebelled against Liang and came begging for troops. The king personally led the army to Yindi Pass, sent Zhou Dewei against Jinzhou, and defeated the Liang army at Meng Ruan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Liu Zhijun turned on Liang and asked Jin for aid. The king led the host to Yindi Pass, sent Zhou Dewei on Jinzhou, and crushed Liang at Meng Ruan.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，梁遣王景仁攻趙，趙王王镕來乞師，諸將皆疑镕詐，未可出兵，王不聽，乃救趙。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year Liang sent Wang Jingren against Zhao. The Zhao king Wang Rong came begging for troops. The generals all suspected Rong was deceiving them and that troops should not be sent; the king would not listen and went to rescue Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the seventh year Liang sent Wang Jingren against Zhao. Wang Rong of Zhao pleaded for help. His officers suspected a trap and urged caution; the king would not hear it and marched to save Zhao.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，敗梁軍於柏鄉，斬首二萬級，獲其將校三百人，馬三千匹。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year he defeated the Liang army at Baixiang, beheaded twenty thousand, and captured three hundred of their officers, with three thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year he routed Liang at Baixiang, took twenty thousand heads, and seized three hundred officers and three thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 進攻邢州，不下，留兵圍之，去，攻魏。

translations.literal: He pressed the attack on Xingzhou but could not take it, left troops to besiege it, and departed to attack Wei.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Xingzhou without success, left a force to blockade it, and pushed on into Wei territory.

sentences.zh: 別遣周德威徇梁夏津、高唐，攻博州，破東武、朝城，遂擊黎陽、臨河、淇門，掠新鄉、共城。

translations.literal: Separately he sent Zhou Dewei to sweep Liang’s Xiajin and Gaotang, attack Bozhou, break Dongwu and Chaocheng, and then strike Liyang, Linhe, and Qimen, plundering Xinxiang and Gongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dewei he sent to overrun Liang’s Xiajin and Gaotang, storm Bozhou, take Dongwu and Chaocheng, and raid Liyang, Linhe, and Qimen, sacking Xinxiang and Gongcheng.

sentences.zh: 燕王劉守光聞晉攻梁深入，乃大治兵，聲言助晉，王患之，乃旋師。

translations.literal: The Yan king Liu Shouguang heard that Jin’s attack on Liang had gone deep and thereupon greatly drilled troops, declaring he would aid Jin. The king was troubled by this and turned his army back.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouguang of Yan, seeing Jin drive deep into Liang country, mustered a great host and announced he would help Jin. Alarmed, the king wheeled his army homeward.

sentences.zh: 七月，會趙王王镕於承天軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he met the Zhao king Wang Rong at Chengtian Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he joined Wang Rong of Zhao at Chengtian Army.

sentences.zh: 劉守光稱帝於燕。

translations.literal: Liu Shouguang declared himself emperor in Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouguang proclaimed himself emperor of Yan.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，遣周德威會鎮、定以攻燕，守光求救於梁，梁軍攻趙，屠棗強，李存審擊走之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year he sent Zhou Dewei to join Zhen and Ding in attacking Yan. Shouguang begged Liang for rescue; the Liang army attacked Zhao, slaughtered Zaoqiang, and Li Cunshen drove it off.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year he sent Zhou Dewei with the armies of Zhen and Ding against Yan. Shouguang called on Liang for aid; Liang struck Zhao and massacred Zaoqiang until Li Cunshen beat them back.

sentences.zh: 八月，朱友謙以河中叛於梁來降，梁遣康懷英討友謙，友謙復臣於梁，而亦陰附於晉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Zhu Youqian rebelled against Liang in Hezhong and came over to Jin. Liang sent Kang Huaiying against Youqian; Youqian again submitted to Liang, yet also secretly attached himself to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhu Youqian of Hezhong broke with Liang and surrendered to Jin. Liang sent Kang Huaiying against him; Youqian bowed again to Liang while secretly leaning on Jin.

sentences.zh: 十年十月，劉守光請降，王如幽州，守光背約不降，攻破之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the tenth year Liu Shouguang asked to surrender. The king went to Youzhou; Shouguang broke faith and would not yield, so he was stormed and taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the tenth year Liu Shouguang offered to submit. The king went to Youzhou; Shouguang reneged and held out until the city was taken by storm.

sentences.zh: 十一年，殺燕王劉守光於太原，用其父仁恭於雁門。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he executed the Yan king Liu Shouguang at Taiyuan and employed his father Rengong at Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he put Liu Shouguang to death at Taiyuan and set his father Rengong to office at Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 於是趙王王镕、北平王王處直奉冊推王為尚書令，始建行臺。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Zhao king Wang Rong and the Prince of Beiping Wang Chuzhi presented a memorial urging the king to become Director-General of the Imperial Secretariat, and he first established a mobile imperial secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong of Zhao and Wang Chuzhi, Prince of Beiping, then presented a register urging him to take the title Director-General of the Imperial Secretariat, and he first set up a field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 七月，攻梁邢州，戰於張公橋，晉軍大敗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he attacked Liang’s Xingzhou, fought at Zhanggong Bridge, and the Jin army was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he struck Liang at Xingzhou, met them at Zhanggong Bridge, and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 十二年，魏州軍亂，賀德倫以魏、博二州叛於梁來附。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Wei prefectural army mutinied; He Delun brought Wei and Bo prefectures over from Liang and came to attach himself to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Wei garrison rose; He Delun defected from Liang with Wei and Bo and joined Jin.

sentences.zh: 王入魏州，行至永濟，誅其亂首張彥，以其兵五百自衛，號帳前銀槍軍。

translations.literal: The king entered Weizhou. When he reached Yongji he executed the mutiny leader Zhang Yan, took five hundred of his troops for his own guard, and styled them the Vanguard Silver Spear Army.
translations.idiomatic: The king entered Weizhou. At Yongji he executed the ringleader Zhang Yan, kept five hundred of his men as a personal guard, and named them the Vanguard Silver Spear Army.

sentences.zh: 六月，王兼領魏博節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the king also held the post of military governor of Weibo.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he added the Weibo governorship to his titles.

sentences.zh: 取德州。

translations.literal: He took Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He seized Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，取澶州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he took Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Cao Prefecture fell to him.

sentences.zh: 劉鄩軍於洹水，王率百騎覘其營，遇鄩伏兵圍之數重，決圍而出，亡七八騎。

translations.literal: Liu Yan’s army was at the Huan River. The king led a hundred horsemen to reconnoiter his camp, met Yan’s ambush ringed round him in many layers, broke through the encirclement and got out, losing seven or eight riders.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan camped on the Huan River. The king rode out with a hundred men to spy on his lines, rode into ambush and was ringed many deep, cut his way free, and lost seven or eight horses.

sentences.zh: 八月，梁復取澶州，晉軍與鄩對壘於莘，晉軍數挑戰，鄩閉壁不出。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liang retook Cao Prefecture. The Jin and Yan armies faced each other at Xin; the Jin army repeatedly challenged battle, but Yan shut his walls and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liang recovered Cao. Jin and Liu Yan faced off at Xin; Jin taunted him day after day, but Yan barred his gates and would not fight.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，王留李存審於莘，聲言西歸。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year the king left Li Cunshen at Xin, declaring he was returning west.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year he left Li Cunshen at Xin and announced a march west.

sentences.zh: 鄩聞晉王且去，即引兵擊魏，攻城東。

translations.literal: Yan heard that the Jin king was about to leave and at once led troops to strike Wei, attacking the east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that the Jin king was withdrawing, Liu Yan marched on Wei and assaulted the east wall.

sentences.zh: 王行至貝州，返擊鄩，大敗之，追至於故元城，又敗之，鄩走黎陽。

translations.literal: When the king reached Beizhou he turned back and struck Yan, utterly defeated him, pursued to Old Yuan City and defeated him again; Yan fled to Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: The king reached Beizhou, wheeled about, and shattered Yan’s host, chased him to Old Yuan City and beat him again, and drove him to Liyang.

sentences.zh: 三月，攻梁衛州，降其刺史米昭；

translations.literal: In the third month he attacked Liang’s Weizhou and its prefect Mi Zhao surrendered;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he besieged Liang’s Weizhou; Prefect Mi Zhao surrendered;

sentences.zh: 克磁州，殺其刺史靳昭。

translations.literal: he took Cizhou and killed its prefect Jin Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: he took Cizhou and executed Prefect Jin Zhao.

sentences.zh: 四月，克洺州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he took Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he seized Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，圍邢州，降其節度使閻寶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he besieged Xingzhou and its military governor Yan Bao surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he blockaded Xingzhou until Military Governor Yan Bao submitted.

sentences.zh: 梁張筠棄相州、戴思遠棄滄州而逃，遂取二州，而貝州人殺梁守將張源德，以城降。

translations.literal: Liang’s Zhang Yun abandoned Xiangzhou and Dai Siyuan abandoned Cangzhou and fled; he thereupon took the two prefectures. The people of Beizhou killed Liang’s garrison commander Zhang Yuande and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun of Liang abandoned Xiangzhou and Dai Siyuan fled Cangzhou, and both prefectures fell to him. At Beizhou the townsfolk killed Liang’s commander Zhang Yuande and opened the gates.

sentences.zh: 契丹寇蔚州，執振武節度使李嗣本。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided Weizhou and seized Zhenwu military governor Li Siben.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan horsemen raided Weizhou and captured Li Siben, military governor of Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 十四年，契丹寇新州，遂寇幽州，李嗣源擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Khitan raided Xinzhou and then raided Youzhou; Li Siyuan drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Khitan struck Xinzhou and pushed on to Youzhou; Li Siyuan beat them back.

sentences.zh: 冬，梁謝彥章軍於楊劉。

translations.literal: In winter Liang’s Xie Yanzhang encamped at Yangliu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Liang’s Xie Yanzhang held Yangliu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，攻楊劉，王自負芻以堙塹，遂破之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he attacked Yangliu; the king himself carried fodder on his back to fill the moat, and so broke the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he assaulted Yangliu; the king shouldered bundles of straw himself to choke the ditch and took the town.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，梁、晉相距於楊劉，彥章決河水以隔晉軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year Liang and Jin confronted each other at Yangliu; Yanzhang cut the river to separate the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year Liang and Jin faced off at Yangliu; Yanzhang broke the levee to wall Jin behind water.

sentences.zh: 六月，渡水擊彥章，破其四寨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he crossed the water and struck Yanzhang, breaking his four stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he crossed the river, hit Yanzhang, and smashed four of his camps.

sentences.zh: 八月，大閱於魏，合盧龍、橫海、昭義、安國及鎮、定之兵十萬、馬萬匹，軍於麻家渡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he held a grand review at Wei, assembling a hundred thousand troops and ten thousand horses from Lulong, Henghai, Zhaoyi, Anguo, and Zhen and Ding, and encamped at Majia Ford.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he reviewed the host at Wei—one hundred thousand foot and ten thousand horse from Lulong, Henghai, Zhaoyi, Anguo, Zhen, and Ding—and camped at Majia Ford.

sentences.zh: 謝彥章軍於行臺。

translations.literal: He faced Xie Yanzhang’s army at the field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He drew up against Xie Yanzhang at the field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 十二月，進軍臨濮，梁軍追之，戰於胡柳，晉軍大敗，周德威死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he advanced to Linpu; the Liang army pursued, and they fought at Huliu. The Jin army was utterly defeated and Zhou Dewei died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he marched on Linpu. Liang gave chase; at Huliu Jin was routed and Zhou Dewei fell.

sentences.zh: 梁軍暮休於土山，晉軍復擊，大敗之，遂軍德勝，為夾寨。

translations.literal: The Liang army at dusk rested on an earthen hill; the Jin army struck again and utterly defeated them, then encamped at Desheng and built linked stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Liang camped at dusk on a hill of earth; Jin hit them again and broke them, then settled at Desheng and threw up twin camps.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，王兼領盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year the king also held the post of military governor of the Lulong army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year he took the Lulong governorship as well.

sentences.zh: 梁王瓚攻德勝南城，不克。

translations.literal: Liang’s Wang Zan attacked the south city of Desheng but could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zan of Liang stormed Desheng’s south citadel and failed.

sentences.zh: 十月，廣德勝北城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he enlarged the north city of Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he expanded Desheng’s north citadel.

sentences.zh: 十二月，敗梁軍於河南。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he defeated the Liang army south of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he routed Liang south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 十七年，朱友謙襲同州，梁遣劉鄩擊友謙，李存審敗梁軍於同州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Zhu Youqian raided Tongzhou. Liang sent Liu Yan against Youqian, and Li Cunshen defeated the Liang army at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Zhu Youqian struck Tongzhou. Liang sent Liu Yan against him; Li Cunshen crushed Liang at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，魏州僧傳真獻唐受命寶一。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year a Wei prefectural monk, Zhenzhen, presented one Tang Mandate of Heaven treasure.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighteenth year a Wei monk named Zhenzhen offered up a Tang “Mandate of Heaven” seal.

sentences.zh: 趙將張文禮弒其君镕，文禮來請命。

translations.literal: The Zhao general Zhang Wenli murdered his lord Rong; Wenli came to request orders.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenli, a Zhao officer, assassinated his prince Wang Rong and came to ask what Jin would have him do.

sentences.zh: 二月，以文禮為鎮州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: In the second month Wenli was made acting commander of Zhenzhou’s army and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wenli was named acting commander of the Zhenzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 三月，河中節度使朱友謙、昭義軍節度使李嗣昭、橫海軍節度使李存審、義武軍節度使王處直、安國軍節度使李嗣源、鎮州兵馬留後張文禮、領天平軍節度使閻寶，大同軍節度使李存璋、振武軍節度使李存進、匡國軍節度使朱令德，請王即皇帝位，王三辭，友謙等三請，王曰：「予當思之。」

translations.literal: In the third month the Hezhong military governor Zhu Youqian, the Zhaoyi army military governor Li Sizhao, the Henghai army military governor Li Cunshen, the Yiwu army military governor Wang Chuzhi, the Anguo army military governor Li Siyuan, the Zhenzhou acting commander Zhang Wenli, the acting Tianping army military governor Yan Bao, the Datong army military governor Li Cunzhang, the Zhenwu army military governor Li Cunjin, and the Kuangguo army military governor Zhu Lingde asked the king to assume the imperial throne. The king declined three times; Youqian and the others asked three times; the king said, “I shall consider it.”
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhu Youqian of Hezhong, Li Sizhao of Zhaoyi, Li Cunshen of Henghai, Wang Chuzhi of Yiwu, Li Siyuan of Anguo, Zhang Wenli acting at Zhenzhou, Yan Bao holding Tianping, Li Cunzhang of Datong, Li Cunjin of Zhenwu, and Zhu Lingde of Kuangguo begged the king to take the throne. He refused thrice; they pressed thrice; he said, “I will think on it.”

sentences.zh: 八月，遣趙王王镕故將符習及閻寶、史建瑭等攻張文禮於鎮州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he sent the late Zhao king Wang Rong’s former general Fu Xi together with Yan Bao, Shi Jiantang, and others to attack Zhang Wenli at Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he sent Wang Rong’s old officer Fu Xi with Yan Bao, Shi Jiantang, and others against Zhang Wenli at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 建瑭取趙州。

translations.literal: Jiantang took Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jiantang seized Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 張文禮卒，其子處瑾閉城拒守。

translations.literal: Zhang Wenli died; his son Chujin shut the city and refused to yield.
translations.idiomatic: Wenli died; his son Chujin barred the walls and held out.

sentences.zh: 九月，建瑭戰死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Jiantang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Shi Jiantang was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 十月，梁戴思遠攻德勝北城，李嗣源敗之於戚城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Liang’s Dai Siyuan attacked the north city of Desheng; Li Siyuan defeated him at Qi City.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Dai Siyuan of Liang struck Desheng’s north citadel; Li Siyuan routed him at Qi City.

sentences.zh: 王處直叛附於契丹，其子都幽處直以來附。

translations.literal: Wang Chuzhi rebelled and attached himself to the Khitan; his son Du imprisoned Chuzhi and came over to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chuzhi turned to the Khitan; his son Du seized him and submitted to Jin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，契丹寇涿州，遂寇定州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Khitan raided Zhuozhou and then raided Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Khitan hit Zhuozhou and pushed on to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月，敗契丹於新城、望都，追奔至於涿州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year he defeated the Khitan at Xincheng and Wangdu and pursued the rout to Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year he beat the Khitan at Xincheng and Wangdu and chased them to Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，閻寶敗於鎮州，以李嗣昭代之。

translations.literal: In the third month Yan Bao was defeated at Zhenzhou and Li Sizhao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yan Bao lost at Zhenzhou and Li Sizhao took his command.

sentences.zh: 四月，嗣昭戰死，以李存進代之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Sizhao died in battle and Li Cunjin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Sizhao fell in battle and Li Cunjin replaced him.

sentences.zh: 八月，梁取衛州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liang took Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liang recovered Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，存進敗鎮人於東垣，存進戰死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Cunjin defeated the men of Zhen at Dongyuan, and Cunjin died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Cunjin beat the Zhenzhou garrison at Dongyuan and was killed in the fight.

sentences.zh: 十月，李存審克鎮州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Li Cunshen took Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Cunshen captured Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 王兼領成德軍節度使。

translations.literal: The king also held the post of military governor of the Chengde army.
translations.idiomatic: The king added the Chengde governorship to his titles.

sentences.zh: 同光元年春三月，李繼韜以潞州叛附於梁。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third month of the first year of Tongguang, Li Jitao rebelled at Luzhou and attached himself to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring third month of Tongguang 1 (923), Li Jitao rebelled at Luzhou and went over to Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，皇帝即位，大赦，改元，國號唐。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the fourth month the emperor took the throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the reign title, and made the state name Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fourth month he ascended the throne, declared a general amnesty, changed the era name, and took Tang as the dynastic name.

sentences.zh: 行臺左丞相豆盧革為門下侍郎，右丞相盧程為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事；

translations.literal: The field headquarters’ left chief minister Doulu Ge became Vice Director of the Secretariat, and the right chief minister Lu Cheng became Vice Director of the Central Secretariat: both were made Grand Masters of the Secretariat with concurrent appointment as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Doulu Ge, left chief minister of the field headquarters, became Vice Director of the Secretariat; Lu Cheng, right chief minister, became Vice Director of the Central Secretariat—both with the rank of Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 中門使郭崇韜、昭義監軍張居翰為樞密使。

translations.literal: The inner-gate commissioner Guo Chongtao and the Zhaoyi army supervisory commissioner Zhang Juhun became commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao, commissioner of the inner gate, and Zhang Juhun, Zhaoyi supervisor, were made commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以魏州為東京，太原為西京，鎮州為北都。

translations.literal: He made Weizhou the Eastern Capital, Taiyuan the Western Capital, and Zhenzhou the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou was named Eastern Capital, Taiyuan Western Capital, and Zhenzhou Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 閏月，追尊祖考為皇帝，妣為皇后：曾祖執宜、祖妣崔氏皆謚曰昭烈，廟號懿祖；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month he posthumously honored his ancestors as emperors and his ancestresses as empresses: great-grandfather Zhiyi and great-grandmother the Lady Cui were both given the posthumous title Zhaolie, with temple name Yizu;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month he raised his forebears to imperial rank: great-grandfather Zhiyi and great-grandmother Lady Cui received the posthumous name Zhaolie and the temple title Yizu;

sentences.zh: 祖國昌、祖妣秦氏皆謚曰文景，廟號獻祖；

translations.literal: grandfather Guochang and grandmother the Lady Qin were both given the posthumous title Wenjing, with temple name Xianzu;
translations.idiomatic: grandfather Guochang and grandmother Lady Qin the posthumous Wenjing and temple name Xianzu;

sentences.zh: 考謚曰武，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: his father was given the posthumous title Wu, with temple name Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: his father the posthumous Wu and temple name Taizu.

sentences.zh: 立廟於太原，自唐高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗為七廟。

translations.literal: He established a temple at Taiyuan, with Tang Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong making seven temples in all.
translations.idiomatic: He founded a temple at Taiyuan, counting Tang Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong among seven altars in all.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，李嗣源取鄆州。

translations.literal: On the renyin day Li Siyuan took Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Li Siyuan seized Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉梁人取德勝南城。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the fifth month the men of Liang took the south city of Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fifth month Liang retook Desheng’s south citadel.

sentences.zh: 六月，及王彥章戰於新壘，敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he fought Wang Yanzhang at the new ramparts and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he met Wang Yanzhang at the new ramparts and routed him.

sentences.zh: 是月，盧程罷。

translations.literal: That month Lu Cheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Lu Cheng was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，梁人克澤州，守將裴約死之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn the men of Liang took Ze Prefecture, and the defending commander Pei Yue died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn’s eighth month Liang took Ze Prefecture; its defender Pei Yue died in the assault.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，李嗣源及王彥章戰於遞坊，敗之。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the ninth month Li Siyuan fought Wang Yanzhang at Difang and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the ninth month Li Siyuan met Wang Yanzhang at Difang and broke him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，如鄆州以襲梁。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the tenth month of winter he went to Yanzhou to strike Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of winter’s tenth month he marched on Yanzhou to fall on Liang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，取中都。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day he took Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he captured Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，取曹州。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day he took Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Cao Prefecture surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己卯，滅梁。

translations.literal: On the jimao day he extinguished Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Liang fell.

sentences.zh: 敬翔自殺。

translations.literal: Jing Xiang killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Xiang took his own life.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，貶鄭玨為萊州司戶參軍，蕭頃登州司戶參軍；

translations.literal: On the bingxu day Zheng Jue was demoted to Registrar of Laizhou and Xiao Xiang to Registrar of Dengzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Zheng Jue was banished to registrar of Laizhou and Xiao Xiang to registrar of Dengzhou;

sentences.zh: 殺李振、趙巖、張漢傑、朱珪，滅其族。

translations.literal: Li Zhen, Zhao Yan, Zhang Hanjie, and Zhu Gui were executed and their clans exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhen, Zhao Yan, Zhang Hanjie, and Zhu Gui were put to death and their families wiped out.

sentences.zh: 己丑，德音降死罪囚，流已下原之。

translations.literal: On the jichou day an edict of grace reduced the punishment of prisoners condemned to death, and those sentenced to exile or below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day a grace edict commuted death sentences and pardoned convicts down through exile.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，復北都為鎮州，太原為北都。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the eleventh month the Northern Capital was restored to Zhenzhou and Taiyuan again made the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the eleventh month Zhenzhou was demoted from Northern Capital and Taiyuan restored as Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復汴州為宣武軍。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day Bian Prefecture was restored as the Xuanwu army.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Bian was again made the Xuanwu command.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，尚書左丞趙光胤為中書侍郎，禮部侍郎韋說：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Zuo Assistant in the Department of State Affairs Zhao Guangyin was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Minister of Rites Wei Yue was made Associate Grand Councillor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Zhao Guangyin rose from left assistant in the Department of State Affairs to Vice Director of the Secretariat; Wei Yue, minister of rites, was named Associate Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，新羅國王金樸英遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day, King Geum Park-yeong of Silla sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, King Geum Park-yeong of Silla sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復永平軍為西都。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Yongping Army was again made the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yongping command was restored as Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如洛京。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, he went to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, he went to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，至自汴州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, gengwu, he returned from Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the twelfth month, he returned from Bian.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李繼韜伏誅。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, Li Jiyao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Jiyao was put to death.

sentences.zh: 繼韜之弟繼達殺其兄繼儔於潞州。

translations.literal: Jiyao's younger brother Jida killed his elder brother Jichou at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyao’s brother Jida murdered his elder brother Jichou at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，畋於伊闕。

translations.literal: On the renchen day, he hunted at Yique.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he hunted at Yique.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，河南尹張全義及諸鎮進暖殿物。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the second year, Henan governor Zhang Quanyi and the various circuits presented warm-hall gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tongguang 2 (924), Zhang Quanyi of Henan and the frontier commands sent gifts for the winter hall.

sentences.zh: 己酉，求唐宦者。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, he sought Tang eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, he called for eunuchs of the old Tang court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，新羅國王金樸英及其泉州範節度使王逢規皆遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, King Geum Park-yeong of Silla and Wang Fenggui, military commissioner of Fan at Quanzhou, both sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the king of Silla and Wang Fenggui, Fan commissioner at Quanzhou, each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，渤海國王大諲譔使大禹謨來。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the Parhae king Geum’s envoy Dayu Mo came.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Dayu Mo arrived as envoy from the Parhae king.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如河陽。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, he went to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, he went to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，至自河陽。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, he returned from Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, he returned from Heyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，七廟神主至自太原，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, the spirit tablets of the seven temples arrived from Taiyuan and were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the tablets of the seven temples came from Taiyuan and were installed in the dynastic temple.

sentences.zh: 朝獻於太微宮。

translations.literal: He offered sacrifice at the Grand Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He made offering at the Grand Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, he performed the seasonal rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he performed the seasonal rites at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，有事於南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, jisi, he performed the suburban sacrifice at the Southern Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the second month he sacrificed at the Southern Altar and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，各臣上尊號曰昭文睿武光孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the various ministers offered him the honorific title Illustrious in Letters, Martial in Valor, and Radiant in Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, his ministers presented the throne name Illustrious in Letters, Martial in Valor, and Radiant in Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸李嗣源第。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, he visited Li Siyuan’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, he called at Li Siyuan’s house.

sentences.zh: 癸未，立劉氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Lady Liu was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Lady Liu was made empress.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，党項來。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the third month, the Tangut came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the third month, Tangut envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜從平汴州及入洛南郊立仗軍士等功臣。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, he rewarded as meritorious those who had pacified Bianzhou and the southern-suburb ceremonial guard soldiers who had taken post.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, he rewarded the men who had pacified Bian and the guard troops who had stood the southern-suburb ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚申，工部郎中李塗為檢視諸陵使。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Li Tu of the Ministry of Works was made inspector of the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Tu of the Ministry of Works was named commissioner to inspect the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 潞州將楊立反。

translations.literal: The Luzhou general Yang Li rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Li, a Luzhou officer, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬寅，教坊使陳俊為景州刺史，內園栽接使儲德源為憲州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the renyin day, the controller of the Music Office Chen Jun was made prefect of Jing Prefecture, and the inner-garden grafting commissioner Chu Deyuan was made prefect of Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of summer’s fifth month, Chen Jun of the Music Office was made prefect of Jing, and Chu Deyuan of the inner gardens was made prefect of Xian.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，渤海國王大湮撰遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, the Parhae king sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the king of Parhae sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李嗣源克潞州。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Li Siyuan took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Li Siyuan captured Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，楊立伏誅。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the sixth month, Yang Li was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the sixth month, Yang Li was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封回紇王仁美為英義可汗。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, the Uighur king Renmei was enfeoffed Khan of Righteous Duty.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Uighur king Renmei was made Khan of Righteous Duty.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，如雷山賽天神。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the seventh month of autumn, at Thunder Mountain he performed the rite of offering to the God of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of autumn’s seventh month he sacrificed to Heaven at Thunder Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月，大雨霖，河溢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, long rains fell and the rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, unending rain swelled the rivers.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，置水於城門，以禳熒惑。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the ninth month, water was placed at the city gates to avert the ill omen of the Fire Star.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the ninth month, water was set at the city gates to ward off Mars.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸郭崇韜第。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, he visited Guo Chongtao’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, he called at Guo Chongtao’s house.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，黑水遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Heishui sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Heishui sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，左熊威軍將趙暉妻一產三男子。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the tenth month of winter, the wife of Zhao Hui, a general of the Left Xiongwei Army, gave birth to three boys at one lying-in.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of winter’s tenth month, the wife of Zhao Hui of the Left Xiongwei Army bore three sons at once.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，畋於伊闕。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the eleventh month, he hunted at Yique.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eleventh month, he hunted at Yique.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至自伊闕。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, he returned from Yique.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, he returned from Yique.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，回鶻使都督安千想來。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, the Uighur envoy and commissioner An Qianxiang came.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Uighur envoy and commissioner An Qianxiang arrived.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，及皇后幸張全義第。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, the emperor and empress visited Zhang Quanyi’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the twelfth month, the emperor and empress visited Zhang Quanyi.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，如東京，毀即位壇為鞠場。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the third year, on the gengzi day, he went to the Eastern Capital and demolished the enthronement altar to make a cuju pitch.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the first month of Tongguang 3 (925), he went to the Eastern Capital, tore down the enthronement mound, and built a cuju field.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，聚鞠於新場。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the second month, cuju was gathered at the new ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the second month, a cuju match was held on the new field.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，射雁於王莽河。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, he shot geese at the Wang Mang River.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, he shot geese on the Wang Mang River.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，突厥渾解樓、渤海國王大諲撰皆遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the Turk Hunjie Lou and the Parhae king both sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Hunjie Lou of the Turks and the Parhae king each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 射雁於北郊。

translations.literal: He shot geese in the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: He shot geese in the northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，射鴨於郭泊。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, he shot ducks at Guo Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, he shot ducks at Guo Marsh.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，射雁於北郊。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, he shot geese in the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he again shot geese in the northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，寒食望祭於西郊。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the third month, on Cold Food and on the fifteen-day-wait sacrifice he made offerings in the western suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the third month, at Cold Food and at the mid-month vigil he offered in the western suburbs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，至自東京。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, he returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改東京為鄴都，以洛京為東都。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the Eastern Capital was renamed Yedu, and Luoyang was made Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Eastern Capital was renamed Yedu and Luoyang became Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，及皇后幸郭崇韜、朱漢賓第。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the fourth month of summer, the emperor and empress visited the residences of Guo Chongtao and Zhu Hanbin.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of summer’s fourth month, the emperor and empress called on Guo Chongtao and Zhu Hanbin.

sentences.zh: 旱。

translations.literal: Drought.
translations.idiomatic: Drought.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，趙光胤薨。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Zhao Guangyin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhao Guangyin died.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，後太妃薨，廢朝五日。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the fifth month, the late imperial consort died; court was suspended five days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the fifth month, the late imperial consort died and court mourned five days.

sentences.zh: 己酉，黑水、女真皆遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Heishui and the Jurchen both sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Heishui and the Jurchen each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，宗正卿李紓為昭宗、少帝改卜園陵使。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the sixth month, Li Shu, director of the imperial clan court, was made commissioner for reselecting the mausoleum sites of Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the sixth month, Li Shu, director of the imperial clan office, was charged to choose new tombs for Zhaozong and the Young Emperor.

sentences.zh: 括馬。

translations.literal: Horses were conscripted.
translations.idiomatic: The court rounded up horses.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the seventh month of autumn, the empress dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of autumn’s seventh month, the empress dowager died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，殺河南縣令羅貫。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the eighth month, Luo Guan, magistrate of Henan County, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the eighth month, Luo Guan, magistrate of Henan County, was executed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，魏王繼岌為西川四面行營都統，郭崇韜為招討使以伐蜀。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the ninth month, Prince of Wei Jiji was made overall commander on all four sides of Xichuan; Guo Chongtao was made pacification commissioner to attack Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the ninth month, Prince of Wei Jiji was made supreme commander of the four-sided Xichuan campaign and Guo Chongtao pacification commissioner to invade Shu.

sentences.zh: 自六月雨至於是月。

translations.literal: From the sixth month rain had continued until this month.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had not stopped since the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，射雁於尖山。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, he shot geese at Pointed Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, he shot geese at Pointed Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，奚、吐渾、突厥皆遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the tenth month of winter, the Xi, Tuyuhun, and Turks all sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of winter’s tenth month, the Xi, Tuyuhun, and Turks each sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊子，葬貞簡太后於坤陵。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, the late Empress Zhenjian was buried at Kun Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the late Empress Zhenjian was buried at Kun Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，高麗遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the eleventh month, Goryeo sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the eleventh month, Goryeo sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 己酉，蜀王衍降。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, the Shu king Wang Yan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Yan of Shu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 郭崇韜殺王宗弼及其弟宗渥、宗訓，滅其族。

translations.literal: Guo Chongtao killed Wang Zongbi and his younger brothers Zongwo and Zongxun, and exterminated their clans.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao put Wang Zongbi and his brothers Zongwo and Zongxun to death and wiped out their families.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，畋於白沙。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the twelfth month, he hunted at White Sands.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the twelfth month, he hunted at White Sands.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自白沙。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, he returned from White Sands.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he returned from White Sands.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛亥，封弟存美為邕王，存霸永王，存禮薛王，存渥申王，存乂睦王，存確通王，存紀雅王。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the intercalary month, his younger brothers were enfeoffed: Cunmei Prince of Yong (邕), Cunba Prince of Yong (永), Cunli Prince of Xue, Cunwo Prince of Shen, Cunyi Prince of Mu, Cunque Prince of Tong, and Cunji Prince of Ya.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the intercalary month he enfeoffed his brothers: Cunmei as Prince of Yong (邕), Cunba as Prince of Yong (永), Cunli as Prince of Xue, Cunwo as Prince of Shen, Cunyi as Prince of Mu, Cunque as Prince of Tong, and Cunji as Prince of Ya.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬戌，降死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the fourth year, on the renxu day, prisoners below the death penalty were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the first month of Tongguang 4 (926), convicts below death were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲子，魏王繼岌殺郭崇韜及其三子於蜀。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Prince of Wei Jiji killed Guo Chongtao and his three sons in Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Prince of Wei Jiji put Guo Chongtao and his three sons to death in Shu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，契丹使梅老鞋裏來。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, the Khitan envoy Mei Lao Xieli came.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Khitan envoy Mei Lao Xieli arrived.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，殺其弟睦王存乂及河中讓國軍節度使李繼麟，滅其族。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, his younger brother Prince of Mu Cunyi and Li Jilin, military governor of the Rangguo army at Hezhong, were killed and their clans exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, his brother Prince of Mu Cunyi and Li Jilin, Hezhong governor of the Rangguo army, were executed and their families wiped out.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，沙州曹義金遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Cao Yijin of Shazhou sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Cao Yijin of Shazhou sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，回鶻阿咄欲遣使者來。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the Uighur Aduyu sent envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Uighur Aduyu sent envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，殺李繼麟之將史武、薛敬容、周唐殷、楊師太、王景、來仁、白奉國，皆滅其族。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, Li Jilin’s generals Shi Wu, Xue Jingrong, Zhou Tangyin, Yang Shitai, Wang Jing, Lai Ren, and Bai Fengguo were killed, and all their clans were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Li Jilin’s officers Shi Wu, Xue Jingrong, Zhou Tangyin, Yang Shitai, Wang Jing, Lai Ren, and Bai Fengguo were put to death and their families wiped out.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，宣徽南院使李紹宏為樞密使。

translations.literal: On the jichou day, Li Shaohong, commissioner of the southern bureau of the palace secretariat, was made commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Li Shaohong of the southern palace secretariat was made commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鄴都軍將趙在禮反於貝州。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, the Yedu army officer Zhao Zaili rebelled at Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhao Zaili, an officer of the Yedu army, rebelled at Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，畋於冷泉。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, he hunted at Cold Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, he hunted at Cold Spring.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮陷鄴都，武寧軍節度使李紹榮討之。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili took Yedu; Li Shaorong, military governor of the Wuning army, marched to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Zaili seized Yedu; Li Shaorong of Wuning marched against him.

sentences.zh: 邢州軍將趙太反，東北面招討使李紹真討之。

translations.literal: The Xingzhou army officer Zhao Tai rebelled; Li Shaozhen, pacification commissioner of the northeast, marched to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tai of Xingzhou rebelled; Li Shaozhen, northeastern pacification commissioner, moved to crush him.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，成德軍節度使李嗣源討趙在禮。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Li Siyuan, military governor of Chengde, marched to attack Zhao Zaili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Li Siyuan of Chengde took the field against Zhao Zaili.

sentences.zh: 三月，趙太伏誅。

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhao Tai was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Zhao Tai was put to death.

sentences.zh: 李嗣源反。

translations.literal: Li Siyuan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siyuan turned rebel.

sentences.zh: 博州守將翟建自稱刺史。

translations.literal: Zhai Jian, the defending commander of Bozhou, declared himself prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Jian, Bozhou’s garrison commander, proclaimed himself prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲子，殺王衍，滅其族。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Wang Yan was killed and his clan exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wang Yan was executed and his family wiped out.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，如汴州。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, he went to Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, he went to Bian.

sentences.zh: 壬申，次滎澤。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, he halted at Rong Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, he halted at Rong Marsh.

sentences.zh: 龍驤指揮軍使姚彥溫以前鋒軍叛降於李嗣源。

translations.literal: Yao Yanwen, commander of the Dragon Soar Direct Army, led the vanguard in rebellion and surrendered to Li Siyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanwen of the Dragon Soar Direct Guard led the vanguard in mutiny and went over to Li Siyuan.

sentences.zh: 嗣源入於汴州。

translations.literal: Siyuan entered Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Siyuan entered Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自萬勝。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, he returned from Wansheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he returned from Wansheng.

sentences.zh: 從馬直指揮使郭從謙反。

translations.literal: Guo Congqian, commander of the Inner Horse Direct Guard, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Congqian, commander of the Inner Horse Direct Guard, rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥朔，皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, dinghai, the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of summer’s fourth month, the emperor died.
